date.as_written: saṃvat 964 miti vaiśākhamāsae [[śuklapaṅse]] pūrṇamāsyāṃ tithau svāti nakṣetre(!) śūra(!)yoge bṛhaspativāra

purpose: for the posthumous merit of the donor's deceased parents Dhanavirasiṃha and Gaṅgālakṣmī (pitā dhanavirasiṃ mātṛ gaṃgālakṣmi nimhaṃ devaṃgata juyā o nimha sayā nāmana)
notes: Mānadeva mentioned in 'mānadevasaṃskārita' is the legendary/historical founder of Cakra-vihāra and not a contemporary person.
